subject: Service stability, renewal path & premium tier proposal
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@fintechx.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@fintechx.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Ongoing latency spikes and renewal timing

Naomi —

We're evaluating our renewal for Q4 and wanted to flag a pattern we've seen across August and early September: repeated p95 latency spikes and a couple of short outages that impacted our checkout microservice. Our infra team logged three incidents (2026-08-10, 2026-08-24, 2026-09-02) where response times jumped and a small percentage of requests retried. This has eroded confidence for our product and procurement is asking for clearer uptime commitments and remediation before we commit to an expansion.

Two asks to start: can you share a remediation plan and your position on SLA credits/exception handling during this renewal window? We also want to understand the path to a premium/predictable tier if available.

Appreciate a prompt reply — we have a renewal decision meeting on Oct 1.

Thanks,
Jordan Lee
Head of Platform
FinTechX

[Attachment: fintehx-incident-summary-aug-sep.csv (report stub)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 12:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Ongoing latency spikes and renewal timing

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear summary and the heads up about your Oct 1 renewal meeting. I'm sorry for the friction you've experienced — we take reliability seriously and want to get you on a clear path before your decision.

High-level plan from our side:
- Immediate: technical mitigation steps to reduce p95/p99 variance (internal action, ETA 72 hours).
- Near-term (2–3 weeks): deploy targeted optimizations and a warm pool to smooth bursts.
- Commercial: offer a 3-month pilot of our Premium Tier (predictable capacity + stronger SLOs) at a discounted uplift and a one-time billing credit to cover verified downtime from the August incidents.

I'll loop Karthik for the technical breakdown and Marissa to coordinate the commercial amendment and credit. Attached is a short summary of the proposed stability action plan and a draft SLA addendum we can iterate on. Can we set a 30-minute call tomorrow (Wed 09/15) to align?

Best,
Naomi Feldman

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@fintechx.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Ongoing latency spikes and renewal timing — technical notes

Jordan / Naomi —

Thanks for sharing the traces during the call. Quick technical summary and proposed mitigations:

Root cause (what we see):
- Short-lived p95/p99 spikes tied to bursty traffic patterns that cause cold KV-cache misses in our embedding/cache layer during sudden traffic ramps.
- On a small subset of model shards, there is increased IO latency under concurrent prefix loads resulting in momentary tail latency.

Immediate mitigations (72 hours):
- Enable aggressive prefix/KV prefetching for FinTechX routes (config change, no restart).
- Increase warm pool size for your dedicated slice to reduce cold starts.
- Apply a traffic-shaping knob we can toggle to smooth spikes while we finish kernel-level optimization.

Near-term (2–3 weeks):
- Roll optimized kernels for the affected shard types (reduces per-token CPU/GPU stalls).
- Add persistent KV snapshotting for your hot prefixes to speed recovery on failover.

SLO proposals for Premium Tier pilot (example):
- p95 generation latency < 120ms, p99 < 350ms (measured at the route level with our tracing hooks).
- Availability 99.95% monthly; credits tiered if availability drops below thresholds.

We will provide the instrumentation for you to independently verify latencies. Once the immediate mitigations are live we'll share before/after dashboards.

—Karthik
Principal Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

[Attachment referenced during call: stability_action_plan.pdf (detailed timeline and telemetry links)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@fintechx.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Final proposal: pilot, credit, and SLA addendum

Jordan —

Following our technical work and the monitoring window, here's the commercial proposal Redwood recommends for your renewal conversation:

1) Pilot: 3-month Premium Tier pilot starting Oct 7, 2026. Discounted pilot uplift of +15% on top of your current rates (pilot credit applied as described below). Includes the SLOs Karthik listed (p95 < 120ms, p99 < 350ms) and priority capacity.

2) Credit: One-time invoice credit equal to 10% of your August invoice applied on first invoice after pilot start to account for verified incidents (we're flexible to refine the measurement windows). For any future month where availability falls below 99.95% we will apply tiered service credits as per the SLA addendum.

3) Addendum: I've uploaded an editable SLA_addendum_v1.docx and a short SLA_terms_summary.xlsx showing the credit tiers, SLO measurement method, and verification procedure. Please review: https://app.redwood.com/accounts/FTX-12345 and the DocuSign link here: https://www.docusign.com/link/FTX-SLA-ADDENDUM-2026

Next steps: Marissa will send the DocuSign for the addendum and schedule a kickoff for the pilot with our onboarding team (targeting Oct 7). If you approve the addendum we'll apply the credit to your account and lock the pilot start.

If you need a different structure (larger credit, shorter pilot, or a committed reserved pool) we can discuss commercial alternatives — Marissa will lead that thread.

Thanks again for working through this with us. We want to earn the renewal and make this predictable for your platform team.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

CC: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwood.ai) — she'll send the DocuSign and pricing summary.
